material_family: Formlabs Tough 1500 Resin V2 (photopolymer, SLA), material code FLTO1502

E_MPa.source: Tonight's Breakerspace tension test, specimen DB-T-S1-FLAT-1 (Type V flat dog-bone, Tough 1500, Form Studio 1): public/data/analysis/results_all.csv, row 'specimen,DB-T-S1-FLAT-1', value 1.1361 GPa, crosshead strain; same value as the EVAL_SPEC_v1 §5 reference table entry 'Tough 1500 V2 (printed, Form Studio 1)', E 1136 MPa.
E_MPa.caveat: Crosshead-only strain includes machine compliance, so this underestimates E. The datasheet value is 1460 MPa (Formlabs Tough 1500 Resin V2 product page, tech specs, https://formlabs.com/products/tough-1500-resin/: 'Tensile Modulus 1460.0 MPa'); EVAL_SPEC_v1 §5a scores this case as the sensitivity run.

nu.source: EVAL_SPEC_v1 §5 reference table, Tough 1500 V2 row: nu 0.35 (marked *assumed* there). The Formlabs page lists no Poisson's ratio. Assumed, typical for glassy/tough polymers.

strength_MPa.source: Formlabs, Tough 1500 Resin V2 product page, tech specs (https://formlabs.com/products/tough-1500-resin/): 'Ultimate Tensile Strength 34.0 MPa' (Form 4, 100 um, Form Cure V2 12 min at 70 C). Same as EVAL_SPEC_v1 §5 [S2].

elongation_at_break_pct.source: Formlabs Tough 1500 Resin V2 product page, tech specs: 'Elongation at Break 155.0 %'. Not used by the judge; supports the damage-tolerance argument.
